thesis.mandate: Control and significant-minority investments in North American B2B software and data infrastructure. Associates screen every CIM against this thesis before a DealCloud record is created.

NORTHWIND ANALYTICS, INC.
Confidential Information Memorandum
Prepared for qualified investors only

Company: Northwind Analytics
Sector: B2B software / data observability
HQ: Austin, TX
Employees: 310

Northwind sells a SaaS platform that traces data pipelines for mid-market manufacturers
and logistics operators. 94% of FY2025 revenue was recurring subscription. [p.9]

Financials (FY2025A)
Revenue: $48.2 million [p.12]
YoY growth: 31% [p.12]
Adj. EBITDA: $11.6 million [p.13]
EBITDA margin: 24% [p.13]
Net debt: $48.7 million [p.18]
Net debt / EBITDA: 4.2x [p.18]
Recurring revenue: 94% [p.9]

Risks
- Customer concentration: top 10 accounts are 38% of ARR [p.22]
- Competitive pressure from hyperscaler observability suites [p.24]

PERNIX THERAPEUTICS HOLDINGS, INC.
Confidential Information Memorandum — December 2018
Guggenheim Securities, LLC · Exhibit 99.2 · EDGAR public exhibit · not in gold set

Company: Pernix Therapeutics
Sector: specialty pharmaceutical / CNS and pain
HQ: Morristown, New Jersey

Headquartered in Morristown, New Jersey, Pernix Therapeutics Holdings, Inc. is a specialty pharmaceutical company focused on the acquisition, development and commercialization of prescription medication, primarily for the U.S. market. Pernix operates through four primary assets: Zohydro ER, Silenor, Treximet, and Generics / Other.

Transaction Overview
Pernix has engaged Guggenheim Securities as its financial advisor to seek proposals for a strategic investment in Pernix or an acquisition of all or a portion of the Company’s assets.

For 2018E, the Company expects to generate $91.1M of Net Sales and $7.9M of Adjusted EBITDA. 2018 adjusted operating expenses are projected to be 33% (or $31 million) lower than in 2015. Adjusted EBITDA nearly doubled from 2016 to 2017 despite a 6.4% drop in Adjusted Net Sales.

Net Sales Forecast ($ in millions)
2017A 146 · 2018E 91 · 2019E 68 · 2020E 57 · 2021E 55 · 2022E 57
Compression in 2018E Treximet franchise revenue driven by loss of exclusivity in February 2018. Silenor LOE to occur in January 2020. No labeled Revenue: or Net debt / EBITDA: lines are provided in this excerpt.

Risks
- Loss of exclusivity on Treximet and Silenor; generic entry
- Opioid franchise, abuse-deterrent labeling, and related litigation
- 20mg Zohydro stockout announced November 2018
- Cost-structure turnaround still in progress
